title.zh: 减少浪费，参与气候行动。

summary.en: Understand food waste's climate connection and the scope of global estimates.
summary.zh: 理解食物浪费的气候联系与全球估计的范围。

whyItMatters.en: A climate fact becomes useful when you know what it measures.
whyItMatters.zh: 知道事实测量了什么，才更容易用它理解行动。

text.en: of global greenhouse gas emissions are linked to food loss and waste.
text.zh: 全球温室气体排放与食物损失和浪费有关的比例。

scope.en: Annual global emissions; food loss and food waste combined. Cited by UNFCCC on 30 September 2024.
scope.zh: 全球年度排放；同时涵盖食物损失和食物浪费。UNFCCC 于 2024 年 9 月 30 日引用。

text.en: Producing food uses energy. Wasting it wastes those resources too.
text.zh: 生产食物需要能源。浪费食物，也浪费了这些资源。

text.en: Learn. Understand. Take action.
text.zh: 学习、理解、行动。

text.en: Plan one meal using what you already have.
text.zh: 用家里已有的食物计划一餐。

statistics.measurementPeriod: Annual global estimate cited in 2024; underlying estimation period not specified in this article

populationScope.en: Global food loss and food waste
populationScope.zh: 全球食物损失与食物浪费

statistics.units: percent of annual global GHG emissions

methodologyNote.en: The article cites a range, not a personal estimate or a measurement from 2026.
methodologyNote.zh: 文章引用的是范围估计，不是个人估计或 2026 年测量。

summary.en: Separate the data year, publication year and sectors covered.
summary.zh: 区分统计年份、发布年份与覆盖领域。

whyItMatters.en: Scope prevents a global estimate being mistaken for household or personal waste.
whyItMatters.zh: 保留范围，避免把全球估计误当作家庭或个人浪费。

text.en: Estimated food waste at consumer levels in 2022.
text.zh: 2022 年消费端食物废弃物估计量。

scope.en: Retail, food service and households, including inedible parts; report released in 2024.
scope.zh: 涵盖零售、餐饮服务和家庭，并包含不可食用部分；报告于 2024 年发布。

text.en: The observation year is 2022. The report date is 2024. Neither makes the estimate a reading of your kitchen today.
text.zh: 统计年份是 2022 年，报告年份是 2024 年；它们都不能让这个数值变成对你今天厨房的测量。

text.en: When sharing a number, include its year, unit and scope.
text.zh: 分享数据时，一起注明年份、单位和范围。

populationScope.en: Global retail, food service and households
populationScope.zh: 全球零售、餐饮服务与家庭

methodologyNote.en: UNEP Food Waste Index Report 2024 estimate, not household waste alone.
methodologyNote.zh: UNEP Food Waste Index Report 2024 估计，不只涵盖家庭。

summary.en: Use Victoria's guide as a starting point, then verify your provider.
summary.zh: 从 Victoria 指引开始，再核对你的服务提供方。

whyItMatters.en: The same material may have different local collection instructions.
whyItMatters.zh: 相同材料在不同地区可能有不同收集要求。

text.en: Find the service for your address. Councils and private providers can differ, including separate glass or food-organics services.
text.zh: 找到服务你住所的提供方。Council 与私人服务商可能不同，包括单独玻璃或厨余收集。

text.en: Do not infer a local rule from bin colour or a material symbol. If a route is unclear, check the specific item before putting it in recycling.
text.zh: 不要根据桶色或材料符号推断当地规则。处理方式不明时，先查具体物品再投回收。

text.en: Look up one uncertain package using your current council or provider guide.
text.zh: 用当前 council 或服务商指引查询一件不确定的包装。

summary.en: A box, wrap and lid can have different instructions.
summary.zh: 盒、薄膜与盖子可能各有处理说明。

whyItMatters.en: Following component instructions helps avoid contamination.
whyItMatters.zh: 按部件说明处理，有助于减少污染。

text.en: Match each component name to its label. A conditional instruction matters as much as the recycling symbol.
text.zh: 将每个部件名称与对应标签匹配。有条件说明与回收符号一样重要。

text.en: If you cannot confirm an item's acceptance, check rather than adding an uncertain item to recycling.
text.zh: 不能确认是否接受时，应先查，不把不确定的物品加入回收。

text.en: Find the instruction for both the container and its lid.
text.zh: 找出容器和盖子分别对应的说明。

summary.en: Check existing food and buy only the missing ingredients.
summary.zh: 查看已有食物，只购买缺少的食材。

whyItMatters.en: Small planning choices address waste before it happens.
whyItMatters.zh: 小的计划选择，可以在浪费发生前发挥作用。

text.en: Check fridge, freezer and pantry. Make a visible use-first area for food that needs attention while still safe.
text.zh: 查看冰箱、冷冻室和储物柜。为仍安全、需要优先使用的食物安排可见区域。

text.en: Choose portions for the people who will eat, and meals that can share ingredients. Update the plan when your week changes.
text.zh: 按实际人数安排份量，并选择能共用食材的餐食。每周安排变化时更新计划。

text.en: Write a short shopping list from one meal built around existing food.
text.zh: 从一餐以已有食物为主的计划，写出简短购物清单。

summary.en: Understand use-by, best-before and required storage.
summary.zh: 理解 use-by、best-before 与必要储存条件。

whyItMatters.en: Reducing waste must respect food safety.
whyItMatters.zh: 减少浪费必须尊重食品安全。

text.en: Do not eat food past its use-by date. Best-before mainly concerns quality, while condition and storage remain relevant.
text.zh: 不要食用超过 use-by 日期的食物。Best-before 主要涉及品质，食物状态与储存条件仍需考虑。

text.en: Follow the label's storage and preparation directions. A date alone cannot account for inappropriate storage.
text.zh: 遵循标签的储存和准备说明，日期本身不能弥补不当储存。

text.en: Check a label's date type and storage directions before making a use-first plan.
text.zh: 安排优先使用计划前，查看标签的日期类型与储存要求。

title.en: Zero Waste Day puts food waste in focus
title.zh: 零废弃日聚焦食物浪费

summary.en: UNEP's 30 March 2026 announcement places food waste at the centre of this year's awareness day.
summary.zh: UNEP 2026 年 3 月 30 日公告，将食物浪费作为当年宣传日的重点。

whyItMatters.en: Connect an everyday prevention habit with wider climate education.
whyItMatters.zh: 把日常预防习惯与更广泛的气候教育联系起来。

text.en: The announcement discusses food waste across homes, businesses and cities. It highlights awareness and practical prevention as part of wider environmental action.
text.zh: 公告讨论了家庭、企业与城市层面的食物浪费，强调意识提升与实际预防在环境行动中的作用。

text.en: Choose a prevention habit to discuss with someone at home.
text.zh: 选择一个预防浪费的习惯，与家里的人交流。

title.zh: Victoria 公布容器回收里程碑

summary.en: On 4 April 2026, the Victorian Government reported more than 3 billion container returns through CDS Vic.
summary.zh: 2026 年 4 月 4 日，Victoria 政府报告 CDS Vic 容器累计回收超过 30 亿个。

whyItMatters.en: A separate collection scheme has eligibility rules as well as public results.
whyItMatters.zh: 专门收集计划既有资格规则，也有公开成果。

text.en: This is a government-reported cumulative milestone at the publication date. It is not this app's return count or a live total.
text.zh: 这是政府在发布日期报告的累计里程碑，并非本 App 的回收计数或实时总量。

text.en: For a return you plan today, use CDS Vic's current eligibility and refund-point information.
text.zh: 如果计划今天退回容器，请查看 CDS Vic 当前的资格与退费点信息。

text.en: Check whether one drink container is eligible before planning a return.
text.zh: 计划退回前，核对一个饮料容器是否符合条件。

title.en: Why food date labels cause confusion
title.zh: 食品日期标签为何容易混淆

summary.en: In a 31 October 2024 article, FSANZ explained the difference between safety and quality date marks.
summary.zh: FSANZ 于 2024 年 10 月 31 日的文章解释了安全与品质日期标记的区别。

whyItMatters.en: This historical article gives context for the storage lesson; it is not a new rule.
whyItMatters.zh: 这篇历史文章为储存课程提供背景，不代表新规则。

text.en: The article distinguishes use-by from best-before. Read current FSANZ guidance and product storage instructions when deciding how to handle food.
text.zh: 文章区分 use-by 和 best-before。处理食物时应结合 FSANZ 当前指引与产品储存说明。

text.en: Explain the two date types in your own words, without saying smell overrides use-by.
text.zh: 用自己的话解释两类日期，但不要说气味可以推翻 use-by。
